input: Maya (Product Designer, Web): “Most of the day went into iterating on the new onboarding flow based on yesterday’s usability test recordings. I went through all eight sessions and tagged moments where users hesitated, especially on the workspace setup and teammate invite screens. The main friction points were ambiguous copy around ‘Organization Name’ vs ‘Project Name’ and a cluttered role selection component that surfaced all advanced permissions up front. I redesigned that part of the flow with a much simpler ‘Recommended setup’ path and moved advanced role customization behind a clearly labeled ‘Configure later’ link. I also updated the Figma prototype to include a progress indicator that clearly shows users they’re on step 2 of 3, which came up as a big reassurance factor in the tests. I’m slightly blocked because I need engineering input on whether we can technically support inline validation for company domain verification in step 1, or if that would require another backend service. My intent for tomorrow is to finalize the high-fidelity designs, hand off annotated Figma frames to Frontend with clear states (loading, error, success), and collaborate with Marketing on a lightweight illustration set so the flow feels welcoming before we lock it for the sprint ending 15th April.”

output.summary: Maya discussed her progress on the onboarding flow, addressing user friction points and updating the Figma prototype, while facing some engineering blockages.

input: Shreya (Backend Engineer): “Today I focused on finalizing the subscription renewal flow for the SaaS billing service. I wired up the cron job that checks for expiring subscriptions every 24 hours, integrated with Razorpay’s recurring payment API, and added basic retry logic for soft failures. I also wrote migration scripts to backfill next_renewal_at for all existing users so we don’t break current subscribers when we deploy. I’m partially blocked on security review for the new billing-webhook endpoint; I’ve tagged Varun in the PR to confirm if we need HMAC signature validation or if IP whitelisting is enough for this sprint. My intent for tomorrow is to close the security feedback, increase unit test coverage from 72% to at least 85% on the billing module, and then start on the revenue recognition report that Finance wants ready before the 12th April audit deadline.”

output.summary: Shreya reported on her work with the subscription renewal flow, addressing integration with Razorpay and a need for security reviews, while outlining her goals for tomorrow.
